items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: And there's like a brother named Johnny. He used to play with Isaiah Morgan all the time.

ctx.x: What about the pinch-back? You want to talk about pinch-back? What about pinch-back?

Pinch-back, he could be a teacher. Yeah, I know. He could play any kind of instrument. When he didn't play, he couldn't play nothing, you know. you teach? And all these scholars used to come to me, you know. And he said, you can't execute the instrument. I said, what can you execute my instrument? I said, man, I can't see it myself. I said, man, I can't see it myself. I said, you know, a long time ago in them day, white people couldn't dance slow. You have to play fast music. I said, man, I can't see it myself. I…
Okay, go ahead. Ask them about the tranchina.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Isaiah Martin. Yeah, I used to work with him.

ctx.x: And ask him if you ever worked with the Young Morgan Band.

Have you ever worked with the Young Morgan Band? Yeah, yeah. Let me see. Isaiah Martin. Yeah, I used to work with him. He played his band. He played for me. He was playing out at Spanish Post. And you know, old man, Transcena, he could play music too. Transcena, that's the fella who used to run the place out there, you know. You know what I was talking about? Transcena? That was the boss, you know, who used to run that, you know, that place out there. But anyhow, he was a great bass fella. He didn't sit in the…
When did you start using ninths? Who? When did you start using- Using ninths?
